name: qa
description: The automated QA pass for Claude Code and the two files it starts from: build-knowledge derives a page's KNOWLEDGE.md from its code, setup-states observes the staging org and records the page states it holds in the project's accounts.md, and prove-branch resolves the run from the checked-out branch, composes flows from the diff, the ticket's acceptance criteria and those two files, drives them in a real browser against the pull request's preview deployment, grades the evidence in a cold-context session, and posts one receipt to the ticket
